description: Assess the feasibility of an indirect treatment comparison (ITC) by walking through the three core assumptions (exchangeability, homogeneity, consistency) and recommending an appropriate method: direct comparison, Bucher, full NMA, anchored MAIC/STC, unanchored MAIC/STC, ML-NMR, NMR/subgroup meta-regression, or infeasible. Cites Cope 2014 (BMC Med), NICE DSU TSD 18 (Phillippo), Signorovitch 2023 (J Dermatol Treatment), and Cochrane Handbook Ch 10-11. Use this BEFORE running evidence.indirect or evidence.population_adjusted to select the right method.

ai_disclosure_level.description: AI assistance disclosure level. "off" = no disclosure; "standard" = default (model/tools/sources/date + human-review reminder); "submission" = adds ISPOR ELEVATE-GenAI citation. Default is tool-specific.

connected_network.description: True if there is a connected evidence network linking the treatments of interest via at least one common comparator.

decisions.description: Methodological decisions made in conversation (source selection, comparator choice, screening criteria, model structure...). Each entry records the choice, the rationale (why), alternatives rejected, and who decided. Embedded in the audit trail Decision Log and, when a project is supplied, appended to wiki/decisions.md for cross-session recall. Tools never invent decisions — only pass what the user made or confirmed. Design log #52.

decided_by.description: Who made the decision — mark honestly

references.description: DOI/PMID/URL — recorded verbatim, rendered as unverified unless verified via utils.verify_citations

effect_modifier_imbalance.description: Severity of imbalance in identified effect modifiers across trial populations. Default 'unknown'.

effect_modifiers_identified.description: True if effect modifiers have been identified through clinical input or literature review. Default false.

h2h_available.description: True if at least one head-to-head RCT compares the treatments directly. Default false.

heterogeneity_i2_pct.description: Optional: I² statistic (%) across studies of the same comparison. If absent, homogeneity is assessed qualitatively.

ipd_available_for_intervention.description: True if individual patient data (IPD) are available from the sponsor's trial. Default false.

n_studies_per_comparison.description: Optional: minimum number of studies per pairwise comparison. Informs choice between Bucher (k=1) and NMA (k≥2).

outcome_type.description: Primary outcome type — guides estimator recommendations.

subgroup_data_available.description: True if subgroup data are available in comparator trials for adjustment. Default false.

name: evidence.itc
